# Feature request

## Proposal

What user problem should ryl solve?

## Research

Link related open or closed issues, pull requests, and
[design decisions](https://github.com/owenlamont/ryl/blob/main/docs/design/decisions.md)
you checked. Explain how the proposal fits
[ryl's scope](https://github.com/owenlamont/ryl/blob/main/docs/scope.md).

## Related issue

Link an existing issue if the proposal builds on one.
